name: parakeet-cpp
description: Parakeet (NVIDIA FastConformer ASR + Sortformer diarization) inference in pure C++/ggml. Ships CTC, TDT, EOU and Sortformer engines under one Engine umbrella, plus the cross-engine StreamEvent API (VadStateChanged / EndOfTurn). Sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp parakeet-cpp/ subfolder; consumes the ggml-speech port. This pin (master ecac5bb7, PR #85) runs the EOU RNN-T decoder as ggml graphs on GPU backends: span-batched joint (16 frames per launch), persistent LSTM/pred state and full-window enc-projection on device, on-device argmax and <EOU> state reset; scalar host decode stays for CPU and OpenCL. RTX 4000 Vulkan EOU RTF drops 0.0052 to 0.0031. Prior pin (master 2e2f4d5, PR #87) places the quantized conformer encoder GEMM weights in the CPU repack extra buffer type on CPU-only runs (q4_0->q4_0_4x8, q8_0->q8_0_4x8), replacing the generic vec_dot path with the block-parallel dotprod/i8mm/AVX2 kernels and closing the CPU-side q4_0-slower-than-q8_0 penalty. Prior pin (master df54e37, PR #83) fixed the on-device TDT predictor multi-layer state persistence.
